name: ZIP-2006 Restricting Transfers into the Orchard Pool

Responds to an Orchard Action circuit soundness vulnerability reported 2026-05-29 (ZIP 257, temporary mitigation then NU6.2). NU6.3 adds the Ironwood pool (Orchard protocol with corrected circuit) behind a ZIP 209 turnstile. The ZIP notes privacy costs: higher action counts and amount leakage when migrating; ZIP 318 and ZIP 326 give mitigation guidance. status taken from the ZIP pages, the ZIP index and GitHub.

adoption: zcash/zips repo: 315 GitHub stars, last commit 2026-11-16 (GitHub API, 2026-11-17)
notes: Created 2021-02-27. A soundness vulnerability in the Orchard Action circuit was reported 2026-05-29 (ZIP 257); NU6.2 and NU6.3 mitigated it, and ZIP 2006 restricts the Orchard pool to withdrawals while Ironwood uses the Orchard protocol with a corrected circuit. Not tiered S because the original pool is being retired. status taken from the ZIP pages, the ZIP index and GitHub.
